statement: Sorted local rational thresholds form maps with at most two locally enumerable preimages,weights Delta/R,n<=R<=2n,and P=I+Q_class/R. Column influence contraction kappa gives sufficient m=ceil[(R/kappa)log(16n/pi_min)] with certified upward rounding. In compiler variables lambda-prime=lambda R,b-prime=b/sqrt(R);old polynomial m/consumer factors remain. Reference preparation is ordinary sequential conditional-amplitude computation for the known one-dimensional factors. Raw coherent source output is NOT identified with a physical CQ density:final dephasing/measurement and the diagonal-adjoint controlled algebra are essential. This is a receiving construction using Temme-Wocjan,not a new generic quantization.
